vendorRationale: music's CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs `npm run build` after checking out music ALONE, so a sibling `../theme.tools` src-alias would break CI. The @theme.tools/blog tarball cannot be installed standalone (its `@theme-tools/shared-utils: workspace:*` dep breaks `file:` install), and `widgets.ts` is fully self-contained (zero cross-package imports — escapeHtml/WidgetError/validation all inline). So the single file is vendored in-repo and aliased via tsconfig `paths` + vite `resolve.alias`.
resyncInstructions: To update: re-copy packages/blog/src/widgets.ts from the theme.tools sibling, then refresh sourceRevision/sourceFileCommit/sourceSha256 above (compute with `shasum -a 256`). Verify `widgets.ts` is still self-contained (`grep -nE "\bfrom\s+['\"]" blog/widgets.ts` must return nothing) before vendoring.
